nodes.question: Comparing the source and edited images, has the mug been moved to the right of the headphones, or does the edit instead leave a visible mug or mug-shaped remnant at its source position while adding one on the right?
nodes.criteria: Complete if the mug is to the right of the headphones and the source mug has been relocated without a visible duplicate or mug-shaped remnant at its source position. Partial if there is progress toward placing a mug to the right but the source mug visibly remains or appears as a remnant, or the relocation is otherwise incomplete. Absent if there is no progress toward placing the mug to the right. Unknown if the images do not provide sufficient evidence to judge placement, progress, or whether an apparent remnant is a mug. Do not infer object identity or count unrelated edits as progress.
nodes.binding: Compare the mug and headphones in the source and edited images; assess their relative placement and whether a mug or mug-shaped remnant remains at the source position.

program.checker_template: Execute exactly the supplied visual check on the source and edited images. Follow its saved binding, criteria and dependency evidence. Do not invent edits or infer an expected overall answer. Return JSON status, concise image-grounded evidence, and confidence (a number from 0 to 1, or null if unavailable). Confidence is your reported confidence in this check's observation, not a calibrated probability. A requested fulfillment check uses complete/partial/absent/unknown. A support check uses pass/fail/unknown. A known negative supporting observation can inform a requested check; it is not automatically uncertainty. Use unknown when the evidence cannot establish the requested fact. Do not count supporting facts as completed edits. Assess only the supplied check, not the overall instruction label.
